7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: A pattern in which one person keeps control over another by limiting their money, their time or their contact with other people.
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: A pattern in which one person keeps control over another by limiting their money, their time or their contact with other people.

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: 一方がもう一方のお金や時間、他人との接触を制限することで保たれる支配の形。抑えているものの内容によって見分ける。
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: お金や時間、他人との接触を制限することで、一人がもう一人を支配し続ける型。

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: 한 사람이 다른 사람의 돈, 시간 또는 다른 사람과의 접촉을 제한함으로써 계속해서 통제하는 패턴이다.
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: 돈이나 시간, 다른 사람과의 접촉을 제한해 상대를 지배하는 반복적인 행태.

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: Comportamento contínuo pelo qual uma pessoa mantém controle sobre outra, limitando seu dinheiro, seu tempo, sua liberdade de movimento ou seus contatos com outras pessoas.
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: Padrão de controle sobre outra pessoa por meio da restrição de recursos, tempo ou convivência.

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: Pola wherein seorang orang mengendalikan orang lain dengan membatasi uang, waktu, atau kontak dengan orang lain, sehingga kebebasannya terus dikurangi.
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: Pola kendali yang terus-menerus membatasi kebebasan orang lain.

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: รูปแบบการควบคุมที่เกิดขึ้นต่อเนื่อง โดยจำกัดเงิน เวลา หรือการติดต่อของอีกฝ่ายเพื่อให้อีกฝ่ายพึ่งพาตนเองและแยกออกจากผู้อื่น
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: รูปแบบการควบคุมผู้อื่นด้วยการจำกัดเงิน เวลา หรือการติดต่อ

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.definition: Zorlayıcı kontrol, bir kişinin başkasının zamanını, parasını veya sosyal ilişkilerini sürekli kısıtlamasıyla sürdürülen denetim örüntüsüdür.
7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.gloss: Bir kişinin başkasını para, zaman ya da başkalarıyla ilişki kurma imkânlarını kısıtlayarak denetim altında tutması.

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.translation: Zorlayıcı kontrol örüntüsü, kısıtladığı şeylerden ve söylediklerinden daha açık biçimde anlaşılır.
การควบคุมแบบบังคับมองเห็นได้จากสิ่งที่ถูกจำกัด เช่น เงิน เวลา หรือการพบผู้คน ไม่ใช่จากคำพูดเพียงอย่างเดียว
Pola kontrol koersif dikenali dari pembatasan yang imposed, bukan dari perkataan yang diucapkan.
O padrão de controle coercitivo é reconhecido pelo que restringe, não pelo que diz.
강압적 통제 여부는 상대에게 말하는 내용보다 어떤 freedoms를 제한하는지에 따라 드러난다.
あの支配は強制支配だった。お金も時間も、友人との連絡も制限されていた。

7600a14f223e6a8bd053d96d6038c57db45ebe03.text: The pattern of coercive control is recognised by what it restricts, not by what it says.

761d4a5727f4c34719db28365debcb3b46c14666.definition: The state in which incoming information exceeds the capacity to process it, so each new item reduces the value of the ones before it.
761d4a5727f4c34719db28365debcb3b46c14666.gloss: The state in which incoming information exceeds the capacity to process it, so each new item reduces the value of the ones before it.
Trạng thái thông tin đến vượt quá khả năng xử lý, khiến mỗi thông tin mới làm giảm giá trị của những thông tin trước đó.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: The distance the car travels from the moment the driver touches the brake to the moment the car stops.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: The distance the car travels from the moment the driver touches the brake to the moment the car stops.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: 運転者がブレーキペダルに触れた時点から、車が完全に停止するまでに進む距離。路面の状態や車の速度によって変わる。
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: ブレーキを踏み始めてから車両が停止するまでに進む距離。

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: 운전자가 제동 페달을 밟은 순간부터 차량이 완전히 멈출 때까지 이동하는 거리. 노면 상태와 차량 속도에 따라 달라진다.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: 운전자가 제동 페달을 밟은 순간부터 차량이 멈출 때까지 이동하는 거리.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: Distância que o veículo percorre entre o momento em que o motorista aciona o freio e o momento em que ele para. Ela depende da velocidade, da aderência e das condições da pista.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: Distância percorrida pelo carro desde o acionamento do freio até a parada completa.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: Jarak yang ditempuh kendaraan sejak pedal rem ditekan hingga kendaraan berhenti. Jarak ini dipengaruhi kondisi jalan, cuaca, dan beban kendaraan.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: Jarak yang ditempuh kendaraan sejak pedal rem ditekan hingga berhenti.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: ระยะทางที่รถแล่นไปตั้งแต่เริ่มกดเบรกจนกระทั่งรถหยุด ซึ่งระยะนี้ขึ้นอยู่กับความเร็ว สภาพถนน และประสิทธิภาพของเบรก
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: ระยะที่รถเคลื่อนที่ตั้งแต่ผู้ขับขี่แตะเบรกจนรถหยุดนิ่ง

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.definition: Sürücü frene bastığı andan aracın tamamen durduğu ana kadar kat edilen mesafedir. Islak yol gibi yüzey koşullarında bu mesafe artar.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.gloss: Sürücü frene bastığı andan aracın durduğu ana kadar kat edilen yol.

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.translation: Islak yolda frenleme mesafesi kuru yolda olduğundan daha uzundur.

Di jalan basah, jarak berhenti lebih panjang daripada di jalan kering.

濡れた路面では、乾いた路面より制動距離が長くなる。

762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.text: On a wet road the braking distance is longer than on a dry road.
762eeed81dbf69e405a07fd38d74e6f53b772d0d.translation: Trên đường ướt, quãng đường phanh dài hơn so với trên đường khô.

7652a5fe49631d549a5a8cc4156a10358e38a199.definition: Đơn vị SI của điện trở; ký hiệu Ω.
The SI unit of electrical resistance.

7652a5fe49631d549a5a8cc4156a10358e38a199.translation: Một điện trở 2 Ω chịu dòng 3 A khi V = 6 V.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.definition: A timed test of logic, numeracy or language, often given before or after the first interview.
765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.gloss: A timed test of logic, numeracy or language, often given before or after the first interview.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.gloss: 論理性や数理処理、言語能力を制限時間内に測る試験。

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.definition: É uma avaliação com prazo definido, frequentemente usada em processos seletivos. Pode acontecer antes ou depois da primeira entrevista.
765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.gloss: Teste cronometrado que avalia habilidades de raciocínio, cálculo ou linguagem.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.definition: Tes berbatas waktu untuk menguji kemampuan logika, perhitungan, atau bahasa. Tes ini sering diberikan sebelum atau setelah wawancara pertama.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.gloss: แบบวัดความสามารถที่มีการจำกัดเวลา

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.gloss: Belli bir yeteneği ölçen ve genellikle süreli sınanan test.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.text: The second stage was a numerical aptitude test with forty questions.

765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.text: The second stage was a numerical aptitude test with forty questions.
765a8d4ec89fec12a715e1aa434b0a655c3c42eb.translation: ขั้นตอนที่สองเป็นแบบวัดความสามารถด้านตัวเลขที่มีคำถาม 40 ข้อ

The number one; a single member of a group.

7693f94c2e9bd09c69d71ff9d646543147859485.definition: The brake hold function is active: it keeps the car still until you press the accelerator. Severity level 1 — Information / Status. Action: Nothing to do. The car creeps when you release the brake, exactly as with an automatic gearbox..

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: The amount of text the model can use at one time: your message, the conversation so far, and any attached document.
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: The amount of text the model can use at one time: your message, the conversation so far, and any attached document.

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: ユーザーのメッセージ、これまでの会話、添付文書などを、モデルが一度に参照できるテキスト量。容量が上限に達すると、古い情報は利用できなくなる。
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: モデルが一度に利用できる文章量のこと。

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: 사용자의 메시지, 지금까지의 대화, 첨부 문서를 모두 합친 분량입니다. 한도를 넘으면 오래된 내용이 모델이 참조하는 범위에서 빠집니다.
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: 인공지능 모델이 한 번에 활용할 수 있는 전체 글의 분량입니다.

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: É o limite de texto que um modelo usa ao mesmo tempo, incluindo a mensagem atual, o histórico da conversa e os documentos anexados. Quando esse limite é excedido, as informações mais antigas podem ficar inacessíveis ao modelo.
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: Janela de contexto é a quantidade de texto que o modelo pode considerar de uma só vez.

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: Jendela konteks mencakup pesan Anda, percakapan sebelumnya, dan dokumen yang dilampirkan. Jika sudah penuh, teks awal mungkin tidak lagi dapat diakses model.
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: Jendela konteks adalah jumlah teks yang dapat diakses model sekaligus.

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: จำนวนข้อความที่โมเดลใช้พร้อมกันได้ในแต่ละครั้ง รวมถึงข้อความของผู้ใช้ บทสนทนาก่อนหน้า และเอกสารแนบ เมื่อเต็มแล้วข้อมูลเก่าจะถูกตัดออกจากการประมวลผล
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: จำนวนข้อความที่โมเดลใช้พร้อมกันได้ในแต่ละครั้ง

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.definition: Kullanıcının mesajını, o ana kadarki konuşmayı ve ekli belgeleri kapsayan, modelin aynı anda işleyebildiği metin sınırıdır. Bu sınır dolduğunda başlangıçtaki içerikler modelin görüş alanından çıkar.
769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.gloss: Modelin aynı anda kullanabileceği metin miktarıdır.

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.translation: Bağlam penceresi dolduğunda belgenin ilk sayfası artık modelin önünde değildir.
เมื่อหน้าต่างบริบทเต็ม หน้าแรกของเอกสารจะไม่อยู่ในสิ่งที่โมเดลอ่านอีกต่อไป

769a805c52a5bc14708b6af441c4e1a3e55fb4af.text: When the context window is full, the first page of the document is no longer in front of the model.

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.definition: When light bounces off tiny bits in the air and spreads out in all directions.
76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.gloss: When light bounces off tiny bits in the air and spreads out in all directions.

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.gloss: 光が微粒子に反射して三方へ広がる現象。

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.definition: 빛이 공기나 물속의 작은 입자에 닿아 여러 방향으로 퍼지는 현상이다. 이 현상 때문에 하늘은 파르게 보인다.

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.definition: É a dispersão da luz quando ela rebate em partículas muito pequenas presentes no ar. Esse espalhamento faz o céu parecer azul durante o dia.
76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.gloss: Fenômeno em que a luz se espalha em várias direções ao encontrar partículas no ar.

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.definition: Hamburan terjadi ketika cahaya terpantul dari partikel kecil di udara dan menyebar ke berbagai arah. Phenomenon ini membuat langit tampak biru.

76a351eeeeca41c0f6a5173e94db18ef84158971.gloss: การกระจายตัวของแสงเกิดเมื่อแสงสะท้อนจากอนุภาคเล็ก ๆ ในอากาศ
